fold_design: Fold f from Stage18 selected causal model tau using validation block 40-50,50-60,60-70,70-80 respectively; next disjoint block 50-60,60-70,70-80,80-90 for residual calibration, followed by 60-70,70-80,80-90,90-100 for evaluation
quantile: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))th sorted residual, infinity when index exceeds n
conditional_rule: observed command change in past 150ms (causal); no future_change used in calibration or policy
timing: nominal dt 5ms, predictor uses issue-time-or-earlier commands, logged command application timing uncertain
limitations: one robot continuous dataset; chronological blocks not exchangeable; split conformal nominal finite-sample guarantee not applicable to dependent drifting recording
project has inspected measured dataset across earlier stages, so the present holdout is chronological, not pristine prospective external data
error bounds describe one-step pose prediction, not obstacle avoidance, docking safety, or physical reliability
reference waveform files deliberately excluded; arbitrary input raw data only
future command changes only used for retrospective audit and never interval construction
